name: d02_electro_shot_lock_emergency_exit
purpose: Team B against team B, team preview and three turns of case fz_7_19 of the differential loop (seed 7, battle 19 of the run), cut after the step with the mid-turn switch. Turn 2: Archaludon charges Electro Shot (no rain), which locks it. Turn 3: its locked Electro Shot goes to its own ally Golisopod, whose Emergency Exit switches it out in the middle of the turn (a PIVOT boundary). Electro Shot's onTryMove has removed the move volatile by then and the recorder's `locked` is made of that volatile alone, but twoturnmove (onLockMove) stands until the residual: the engine is locked still, and the converter says the same. Found by the differential loop ("locked 1/0 ... reference 255/0").
